description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for managing course enrollments, including enrolling a learner into a course and listing current learner enrollments. It interacts with a database to store enrollment data and create calendar events for course start and end dates.

methods.name: isValidId
methods.description: Validates if the input is a positive integer ID.

methods.name: isLearner
methods.description: Checks if the user role is 'learner'.
